description: This file defines the AICVADAnalyzer class, a voice activity detection (VAD) analyzer that integrates with the AIC SDK backend. It includes methods for initializing, configuring, and querying the VAD, with lazy backend binding and parameter management.

classes.name: AICVADAnalyzer
classes.description: A VAD analyzer that lazily instantiates and manages an AIC VoiceActivityDetector backend, allowing configuration of lookback buffer size and sensitivity, and providing voice activity confidence scores.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the AICVADAnalyzer with optional factory and parameter overrides.

methods.name: bind_vad_factory
methods.description: Attaches or replaces the VAD factory post-construction and initializes the backend.

methods.name: _apply_backend_params
methods.description: Applies optional AIC VAD parameters (lookback buffer size and sensitivity) to the backend if available.

methods.name: _ensure_backend_initialized
methods.description: Ensures the backend VAD is instantiated, using the factory if necessary.

methods.name: set_sample_rate
methods.description: Sets the sample rate for audio processing and attempts backend initialization.

methods.name: num_frames_required
methods.description: Returns the number of audio frames needed for analysis, based on a 10 ms window.

methods.name: voice_confidence
methods.description: Returns a confidence score (0.0 or 1.0) indicating speech detection in the provided buffer.
